day.emptyBodyToday: Log a meal below, or just tell your AI what you ate.

day.itemMacros: protein {protein} g · carbs {carbs} g · fat {fat} g
day.noPhase: No goal phase set — totals only.
day.loadFailBody: The API could not be reached. Reload to try again.

revisePage.title: Revise log
revisePage.notOnToday: This log is not on today's sheet.
revisePage.notOnThat: This log is not on that day's sheet.
revisePage.hint: Open the day it belongs to and tap the meal there.

logForm.searchFailed: Search failed — check the connection and type again.
logForm.noMatch: No match. Fineli knows most Finnish foods — try another spelling.
logForm.emptyPlate: Nothing on the plate yet — search above and tap a food to add it.
logForm.notesPlaceholder: Anything worth remembering about this meal.
logForm.markEaten: Mark as eaten — count it toward the day
logForm.noAnswer: The kitchen did not answer. Try again.

weight.title: Weight
weight.replaces: Same day, new number? Log again — it replaces.
weight.asIs: The number is stored as-is. Trends and smoothing come later — a single morning is just a step, not the whole journey.

goal.title: Goal phase
goal.closesOld: Opening a new phase closes this one the day before the new start — past days keep their old target.
goal.noPhase: No phase is open. Days are logged without a target until one starts.
goal.restNote: Unmarked days use the rest-day target; a training day is marked on the day sheet.
goal.phaseTargets: rest {kcalRest} kcal · {proteinRest} g — training {kcalTraining} kcal · {proteinTraining} g protein
goal.startsKeep: Starts — leave as is to keep

profile.title: Profile
profile.tzNote: The timezone decides when your day rolls over — a 00:30 snack belongs to the new day.
profile.bodyNote: Optional. Used for energy arithmetic later; never judged.
profile.coachingPlaceholder: In your own words — your AI reads this with every summary.
profile.apiNoAnswer: The API did not answer. Try again.

welcome.title: One name, drawn for you
welcome.intro: Inside Annos you are a nickname, not an email. Roll until one feels right — it is permanent after this page.
welcome.drawFailedBody: The API did not answer. Try the dice again.
welcome.failedBody: The API did not answer. Try again.

auth.oauthNotice: An application is asking to access your Annos data. Sign in to continue.
auth.quarantine: Your email stays with the sign-in system — the tracker itself never sees it. Inside Annos you are only your nickname, drawn on the next page.

templates.title: Templates
templates.emptyBody: Build a plate on the log page and save it as a template.
templates.yieldNote: For recipes: the whole batch weighs this much, and a portion can then be logged in grams.
